snippet.title: In Hope Voiden - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Twelve soldiers. One life each. No respawns.

In Hope Voiden is a retro-inspired first-person survival horror game where death is permanent and the world remembers your failures. Enter a forbidden, war-torn zone where something horrific has happened — and no one sent inside has ever returned.

Take control of a roster of twelve handcrafted characters, each with their own story, traits and personal mission. When one dies, another takes their place and the journey continues. Lost items stay lost, previous actions persist and every failure becomes another piece of the mystery surrounding the zone.

Scavenge scarce resources, manage your inventory and explore trenches, bunkers and ruined fortifications while completing tense real-time interactions where enemies won't wait for you to finish.

Wishlist In Hope Voiden now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726180/In_Hope_Voiden/
